assertions.name: u_is_quadratic_in_q_minus_1_scalar_route_singular
assertions.source: Decisive structural finding: u = b(q)·ℏ_q² has its lowest nonzero order at t² (t = q-1), since ℏ_q = (q-1)/q ~ t. Hence u has no linear term, the u(t)→t(u) reversion is singular, and the c_k cannot be scalar-q Taylor coefficients. This rules out the scalar exact-Δ(net) shortcut and confirms the c_k are irreducibly operator-valued (T_β matrix ladder), requiring the Hoefsmit-rep construction.
